## Notes

Raspberry Pi Pico W (RP2040, Cortex-M0+, 264 KiB SRAM) on Zephyr 3.7, serial only. Wokwi twin booted the C talker over UART0, the Wokwi serial monitor, with the console on UART1 (phase-524 W1 rerun). The image needs `CONFIG_TICKLESS_KERNEL=n` (in the board's prj.conf) and five RAM knobs stated per image until descriptor `[knobs]` can carry them (issue 2194; see the descriptor header). Each twin run needs a `WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN` and spends that account's simulation minutes.

See [Board Support Levels](../board-support-levels.md) for what each status means.
